hypothesis: Two source-specific DeepCenter models trained on disjoint official embryo folds can provide a leakage-controlled visual confirmation signal for attributed synthetic gap recovery.
architecture_source: Pilkwang Kim biohub-deepcenter-unet3d-center-prior-v1, CC0-1.0; training implementation preserved in the support pack.

folds.44b6: 10 predeclared train movies, 2 predeclared source checkpoint-validation movies
folds.6bba: 10 predeclared train movies, 2 predeclared source checkpoint-validation movies

training.checkpoint_selection: lowest loss on the two held-out source movies only

data_boundary: Only each model's own source embryo is discoverable during training. No opposite-embryo target-development or locked-audit movie is opened in EXP180.
success_gate: Both folds must complete exactly two finite-loss epochs, preserve the exact disjoint 10/2 manifests, and produce SHA-recorded best and last checkpoints.
next_if_pass: EXP181 scores the frozen synthetic-gap mechanism on the two held-out source movies of each fold. This does not itself authorize official-24 target evaluation or Kaggle submission.
resource: One RTX6000 job through the common queue; 8 CPU threads, 32 GiB RAM, 2 GiB expected growth, 90 minutes. Models run sequentially under one project lease.
